# 1. Input data files

This script reads all raw source data files into R using `haven::read_dta()` and saves each as an `.rds` file for use in downstream processing steps. File paths are constructed using `fs::path()` relative to two root path variables — `hrs_data_path_source` (raw HRS/HCAP source data) and `hrs_data_path_derived` (derived HCAP products).

All files are in Stata `.dta` format. No recoding or variable transformation is performed at this stage.


## HRS Core Files

### Tracker

| Object | Source File | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tracker` | `trk2022v1/trk2022tr_r.dta` | HRS tracker file (2022 release); contains sampling design variables, wave membership indicators, weights, and demographics for all HRS respondents |

### Section Files (all four waves)

Section files are read for four HRS waves. Each wave contributes four sections:

| Section | Description |
|---|---|
| A (`H{yy}A_R.dta`) | Household and respondent identifiers, age |
| C (`H{yy}C_R.dta`) | Coverscreen / sample information |
| D (`H{yy}D_R.dta`) | Cognition and functional status |
| G (`H{yy}G_R.dta`) | IADL battery |

## HCAP Files

| Object | Source File | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `hc16hp_r` | `HCAP/HCAP2016/HC16sta/hc16hp_r.dta` | HCAP 2016 sampling weights |
| `normexcld` | `HCAP/2016/normexcld.dta` | Normative exclusion flags for the HCAP 2016 normative sample |
| `hrshcap` | `HCAP/2016/hrshcap.dta` | HCAP 2016 clinical diagnoses and cognitive domain impairment flags |
| `hcap_validation` | `stata/20240228-040.dta` | HCAP validation subsample (N=50); local project file |


## External Cognitive Classification Files

These are user-contributed datasets distributed through the HRS data portal.

| Object | Source File | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `langa_weir` | `LangaWeir2020v2/cogfinalimp_9520wide.dta` | Langa-Weir dementia classification, waves 1995–2020, wide format |
| `hurd` | `DementiaPredictedProbabilities/pdem_withvarnames.dta` | Hurd dementia predicted probabilities (available through wave 2007 only) |
| `hudomiet` | `PredictedCognitionDementiaMeasures/Dementia_HRS_2000-2016_Basic_Release1_2m.dta` | Hudomiet probabilistic cognitive classification, waves 5–13 (2000–2016) |
